map.输入轴承直径、长度、转速、载荷及工况，计算比压、PV值、所需油量并推荐润滑方式: Enter the bearing diameter, length, speed, load and operating conditions to compute the contact pressure, PV value and required oil quantity, and recommend a lubrication method
map.💡 公式：比压 p=W/(d·L)；速度 v=π·d·n/60000；PV值=p: 💡 Formula: contact pressure p=W/(d·L); speed v=π·d·n/60000; PV value=p·v; friction coefficient f≈2π²·η·n/(p·ψ); oil quantity Q=f·W·v/(ρ·cp·ΔT)
map.径向滑动轴承 L/d 一般取 0.5~1.5，过大易偏载发热: For radial plain bearings L/d is usually 0.5-1.5; too large tends to cause eccentric loading and heating
map.PV 值反映轴承发热倾向，巴氏合金许用 PV 约 10~15 MPa·m/s: The PV value reflects the heating tendency of the bearing; the allowable PV for babbitt is about 10-15 MPa·m/s
map.油粘度选取：低速重载用高粘度（46~68），高速轻载用低粘度（10~22）: Oil viscosity selection: high viscosity (46-68) for low speed and heavy load, low viscosity (10-22) for high speed and light load
map.相对间隙 ψ 一般取 0.5‰~3‰，精度高取小值: The relative clearance ψ is usually 0.5‰-3‰, taking the smaller value for high precision
map.润滑油量需满足散热要求，循环润滑需保证足够流量: The oil quantity must meet the heat-dissipation requirement, and circulating lubrication must ensure sufficient flow
map.比压 p=W/A、PV=p·v 校核润滑状态。: Check the lubrication state via the contact pressure p=W/A and PV=p·v.
map.按供油量与功耗选定泵与管路。: Select the pump and piping from the oil supply and power consumption.
map.载荷 W=5 kN、投影面积 A=50×20=1000 mm²、v=2 m/s：: Load W=5 kN, projected area A=50×20=1000 mm², v=2 m/s: p=5000/1000=5 MPa; PV=5×2=10 MPa·m/s. Below the allowable value, so hydrodynamic lubrication holds.
Flow Q=10 L/min, supply pressure 0.5 MPa: pump power ≈ p·Q/60 = 0.5×10/60 ≈ 0.083 kW (efficiency ignored).
map.PV 超限怎么办？: What if the PV exceeds the limit?
map.增大面积、降速、换高 PV 材料（如加青铜/PTFE）或改强制润滑，否则进入边界: Increase the area, reduce the speed, switch to a higher-PV material (such as bronze/PTFE addition) or adopt forced lubrication; otherwise boundary wear sets in.
map.需足够速度、粘度与间隙形成楔形油膜，低速重载易转为边界润滑，需极压添加剂。: Sufficient speed, viscosity and clearance are needed to form a wedge oil film; low speed with heavy load tends to shift to boundary lubrication and requires extreme-pressure additives.
map.润滑系统设计计算器，依据轴承直径、长度、转速、载荷与润滑油粘度，计算轴承比压、表: A lubrication system design calculator: from the bearing diameter, length, speed, load and oil viscosity it computes the bearing contact pressure, surface speed, PV value, friction power and required oil flow, and recommends a suitable lubrication method for the operating conditions.
map.计算比压、速度、PV值三大核心指标: Computes the three core indices: contact pressure, speed and PV value
map.按 Petroff 公式估算摩擦系数与功率: Estimates friction coefficient and power by the Petroff equation
map.基于散热要求计算所需润滑油量: Computes the required oil quantity from the heat-dissipation requirement
map.按速度与轴承类型推荐润滑方式: Recommends a lubrication method by speed and bearing type
map.PV值校核与材料选型: PV value check and material selection
